name: e-labay-tooling
description: Firebase CLI, emulator and security-rules test tooling for E-Labay (the app itself is Flutter).

scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-elabay
scripts.test:integration: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-elabay "node --test tests/integration"
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration
